prompt:
Create a high fidelity portrait mobile responsive UI approval mockup for "Lojas Manu" furniture store PDV dashboard, using the previous generated desktop reference as the exact visual system and content source, and reference logo as the existing identity. One full-page mobile dashboard image, width approximately 430px and enough height (about 1750-1950px) to show all sections; no phone frame, no perspective, no browser chrome. This is the same dashboard rearranged for mobile, not a new design. Preserve white cards, blue #0369a1, light #f8fafc background, dark #0f172a, secondary #475569, #e2e8f0 1px borders, 12px corner radius, clean Inter/Segoe UI. No decorative images, gradients, shadows, glass, fake sparklines or bottom tab navigation. Use simple consistent line icons.

Header: white topbar with hamburger icon, a small accurate existing mascot logo, single title "Visão geral", green connection dot. The sidebar becomes a drawer trigger, it is NOT permanently visible. Below: full-width dropdown "Mês até hoje", compact outlined "Atualizar" and blue "Abrir PDV" buttons on a second row, with comfortable touch targets. Show "01–03 out 2026" and "Comparação: 01–03 set 2026" in readable short lines. Visible quiet banner "Prévia visual · dados demonstrativos". Compact "Hoje: R$ 4.850,00 · dia em andamento". Do not put a day of week anywhere.

Exactly four cards in a 2x2 grid, correct readable labels and tabular numbers with no clipping: "Vendas no período" R$ 18.450,00 and green arrow "↑ 12,5%"; "Vendas finalizadas" 12 and green "↑ 20,0%"; "Ticket médio" R$ 1.537,50 and red "↓ 6,3%"; "Pedidos pendentes" 18 with quiet "Todos os períodos". Values should fit naturally through responsive font sizing, no wrap splitting currency. A shared note below grid "Variações em relação ao período anterior" so comparisons remain clear without repeating long text.

Next white panel full-width: "Evolução das vendas" with tiny legend "Atual" blue bars and "Anterior" gray dashed line. 3-day comparative chart Oct1–3, actual bars R$6000,R$7600,R$4850; previous line R$5400,R$6200,R$4800, y-axis R$0/R$4mil/R$8mil, x-axis01out/02out/03out. Blue bars, gray dashed line, subtle light horizontal grids. Do not show overlapping numeric labels in the chart; values are available via "Ver valores por dia" footer link. Small info icon for sales-by-order-date semantics.

Next white panel full-width: "Pendentes para retomar", small "Ver todos", quiet "Mais antigos primeiro · todos os atendimentos". Five compact rows #5902 Ana Oliveira,28/09 · Venda,R$2.490,00; #5908 João Santos,29/09 · Orçamento,R$3.200,00; #5910 Carla Lima,30/09 · Venda,R$980,00; #5916 Pedro Souza,01/10 · Venda,R$1.750,00; #5918 Maria Costa,02/10 · Orçamento,R$2.100,00. Names and numbers left, metadata secondary below, totals right, no big icons or excessive space, no overdue claims.

Next full-width white panel "Pedidos recentes" with "Ver todos", exactly five compact readable rows adapted from a table: #5924 Beatriz Silva,03/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.650,00; #5923 Marcos Rocha,03/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.200,00; #5922 Luana Mendes,02/10 · Orçamento,Pendente,R$3.180,00; #5921 André Lima,02/10 · Venda,Confirmado,R$1.200,00; #5920 Clara Alves,02/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.490,00. Right aligned totals, subtle small outlined green/amber/blue status badges below relevant name. No horizontal scrolling.

Last full-width panel "Produtos com maior valor vendido", "Após descontos". Five rows: Sofá 3 lugares R$6.000,00 ·3 UN; Guarda-roupa 6 portas R$4.800,00 ·2 UN; Cama box casal R$3.600,00 ·3 UN; Mesa com 4 cadeiras R$2.400,00 ·2 UN; Painel para TV R$1.650,00 ·2 UN. Small furniture line icons by relevant type. Make bars precisely proportional on equal-width tracks: blue filled lengths 100%,80%,60%,40%,27.5%, no rounding to equal lengths. White space remains calm and efficient. Footer "Atualizado às 10:42 · Fortaleza". All Brazilian Portuguese text. Every section readable without clipping, no invented metric or feature.
notes: Mockup gerado; não é captura de aplicação. Na implementação, manter título no topbar, usar subtítulo PDV Lojas Manu e adaptar pedidos a linhas móveis sem comprimir uma tabela de desktop.
